read: read-call-outcomes {} returns calls[] not yet reviewed: session_id, call_date, recorder, applied[] (candidate_id, kind next_step|phase_move, deal_id, deal_name, deal_version, payload, evidence_quote, applied_at, undone_at) and open_cards[] (candidate_id, resolver, kind, deal_id, deal_name, payload, evidence_quote). send is always false.
write: undo-call-change {candidate_id, base_version} reverts one applied change; newer_change_exists and version conflicts are refusals to show, never retried. review-call-outcome {session_id} takes one call off Home.
review: Show each applied change with what changed, its transcript quote and one Undo. Count open cards; they are decided in their own review lists.
